Building a reliable financial product for Indian investors requires balancing rigorous research with real-world execution. In this video, I take you behind the scenes of creating Finology 30, our flagship product that delivers 2 to 3 handpicked stock recommendations every month, building a robust portfolio of 30 to 35 well-researched stocks over one year.
What You Will Learn:
• Our Stock Selection Framework: How we filter thousands of companies down to the best long-term opportunities.
